title: Jebel Sahaba cemetery
place: Nile Valley near the Sudan-Egypt border (now under Lake Nasser), Sudan
summary: At least 64 people buried, many with healed and fresh injuries and stone points in their bodies, showing repeated raids.
why: Among the oldest evidence of organised, recurring violence between groups.

notes.problem: Place 'Wadi Halfa' not in source; source: 'in the Nile Valley (now submerged in Lake Nasser), near the northern border of Sudan with Egypt'.
